title: •Talon Karrde
caption: •Talon Karrde (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. If your {ovs} objective on table: aliens are forfeit +2 at Rebel Cell sites; Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell site, ignores Jedi, is {alter}, and for remainder of game, you retrieve Force with it only once per turn.
game_text_lines:
{pilot:2}. If your {ovs} objective on table: aliens are
forfeit +2 at Rebel Cell sites; Yerka Mig may
deploy on a Rebel Cell site, ignores Jedi, is {alter},
and for remainder of game, you retrieve Force
with it only once per turn.
lore: *Smuggler* and *information broker*. Operates intelligence network. Pragmatic businessman. Strong sense of personal honor. Bounty placed on his head by Grand Admiral Thrawn.

notes: Group: Rebel Cell. Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only) — same as printed; deploy 3 / forfeit 4. Leading yellow LS pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2}. INLINE gold sphere before 'objective' = the VS15 set symbol (gold disc with figure, same as the cover symbol and the slip's own set sphere) → {ovs} (i.e. Hidden Base (V)); the stub drops it and its note calls it an 'Independent set icon' — wrong. Red circle-slash A after 'is' → {alter}. Icon column: pilot (yellow LS helmet). Affiliation Alien (wiki subtype; printed Ref II frame). LORE: wiki text matches; 'Smuggler' and 'information broker' are visibly bold on the 354 px scan and on the VB4 reissue → *bold*. Printed card's Reflections II ring stays. Base scan 354×492 only; copyright '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' read off the scan. Modern: VB4-L-talonkarrde-pre.gif (354 px, Virtual Block 4).
